chapter.heading: A Song of degrees.
chapter.v:
Many a
time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

Many a
time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

The plowers
plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

The LORD
is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

Let them
all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

Let them
be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

Wherewith the
mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

Neither do
they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
